title: DJIA Market Happenings For Friday, January 4, 2019
text:
DJIA Market Happenings For Friday, January 4, 2019 Posted by admin on January 4th, 2019
There are no Dow stocks at 52 week highs. Dow stock 52 week lows include Apple (AAPL), down -9.86% year-to-date.
The Market
Premarket today, the Dow was indicated to open up +290 points.
Thursday the Dow was down -660.02 (-2.83%) at 22,686.22.
Year-to-date the Dow is down -2.75%.
There was 1 Dow stock up Thursday.
The Dow stock winner Thursday was Verizon (VZ) +0.36%.
The Dow stock losers Thursday were led by Apple (AAP) -9.96%, Intel (INTC) -5.50%, United Technologies (UTX) -4.45%, Cisco (CSCO) -4.38%, Boeing (BA) -3.99%, Caterpillar (CAT) -3.85%, 3M (MMM) -3.77%, DowDuPont (DWDP) -3.69%, Microsoft (MSFT) -3.68% and Visa (V) -3.60%.
The Bureau of Labor Statistics reported that non-farm payrolls rose to 312,000 in December, surging past expectations of 184,000. The November figure for non-farm payroll additions rose to 176,000, from 155,000 previously reported. The unemployment rate rose to 3.9% in December. The unemployment rate was 3.7% in November, the lowest overall unemployment level since 1969. The uptick was due to the labor force participation rate increasing to 63.1% in December from 62.9% in November. Average hourly earnings increased 0.4% over last month and 3.2% over the previous year. This exceeded expectations of wage growth of 0.3% over last month and 3% over last year. Wages rose 3.1% over the prior year in both November and October.
European stocks are higher and Asian markets ended mostly higher.
The national average price of gasoline is up one-tenth of a cent at $2.250 per gallon.
Earnings Reports .
JPMorgan (JPM) reports earnings on 1/15/2019 before the market open.
UnitedHealth (UNH) reports earnings on 1/15/2019 before the market open.
